_comment: Generated by deployment/shared/generate.mjs. Import into Pterodactyl 1.x, Pelican or WISP.
name: SquadXO
author: squadxo@users.noreply.github.com
description: Public compiled SquadXO releases. Configure config.json yourself. Updates retain all user files and previous application versions.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export PATH="/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
node --input-type=module -e "try{const m=await import('data:text/javascript;base64,');await m.install(await m.release(process.argv[1],process.argv[2]));}catch(e){console.error(e.message);process.exitCode=1;}" "${SQUADXO_REPO:-vohk/SquadXO}" "${SQUADXO_TAG:-latest}"

variables.name: Public GitHub repository
variables.description: Public repository publishing SquadXO deployment archives, not source archives.

variables.name: Release tag
variables.description: latest or an exact v-prefixed public release tag.
